qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum tightening torque for an M14 8.8 screw?
Which M14 screw grade has the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: M14 12.9 has the highest torque at 220 Nm (ft. lbs.)

qa_pairs.question: What is the torque difference between M14x1.5 8.8 and M14x1.5 10.9?
qa_pairs.answer: The difference is 57 Nm, with M14x1.5 8.8 at 143 Nm and M14x1.5 10.9 at 200 Nm (ft. lbs.)
